reason: I like that the lab is named and the report is for my batch, that is what I check first. But $25 to $30 a month is a lot on my budget when I can get magnesium bisglycinate in a bottle for much less, and I already forget my vitamins on the counter.
objection: I pay for the sachet and the packaging, not more magnesium. Two capsules a day for $30 is more than I can justify, and Made in China makes me want to see that report myself before I trust it.
would_change_my_mind: A price near $15 to $18 for 30 days, or a cheap trial box so I can read the real lab report and see if I even remember to take it.
